title: Durable Broker Service and Remote Pull-Runner
summary: Replace the Steel-Mission execution core with a durable, transactional job service and a pull-based runner that executes in customer infrastructure. Today state is one unlocked JSON document with last-writer-wins semantics, execution is a synchronous subprocess call with a fixed cap and silent output truncation, job requests carry host-local paths, and two disjoint orchestration paths exist that never write to each other. Connector delivery has no retry, no backoff and no dead-letter path. The project ends when one storage interface with a SQLite default and a PostgreSQL option backs a single orchestration path, a remote runner claims work over gRPC and returns signed attested results, and connector ingress and egress are transactional.

estimate.rule: Effort estimated per category and divided by an expected acceleration factor, with security-sensitive and novel-integration work held at the cautious end and irreducible empirical time counted at no acceleration.
estimate.redefense: Scope, risk categories and irreducible empirical work are unchanged at the second 2026-08-20 resume boundary after MS-0012, so the focused estimate remains 16.1 days and the delta is +0.0 focused days. The pause began and ended on the same date, so the already reset targets remain true and do not move again.
estimate.note: A focused-day figure is a planning estimate, never a commitment and never evidence that work is on schedule. Re-defend at every milestone boundary and print the delta.

decisions.decision: One storage interface. SQLite backend on the standard library is the default; a PostgreSQL backend on psycopg is the high-availability option.
gRPC bidirectional streaming is the pull-runner transport. Message bodies are canonical JSON validated against the v2 schemas; protobuf is framing only.
Scope is a full core replacement across P1 to P4. Enterprise high availability, multi-tenancy and regional failover are documented as later phases; the schema must not preclude them.

The new root package is steel_core/, not present_core/. The plan as written asked for both a present_core package and a repository that names only Steel-Mission; those conflict, and renaming later costs a second pass through a 227-test suite that drives the binaries as subprocesses.
decisions.supersedes: The present_core/ package name in the originating plan.

decisions.decision: The database is the queue. The broker CLI, the daemon and the chat server are all direct clients of one transactional store sharing one command module and one state machine. There is no CLI-to-daemon RPC.

metadata.pauseReason: Paused again when PRJ-0000 reopened for MS-0012. Decision PRJ-0000-D2 is binding and says PRJ-0000 runs first; leaving both projects ACTIVE would have contradicted it silently. MS-0012 is budgeted at half a focused day, so the target dates are kept rather than cleared and re-set: they are not yet wrong, and churning them twice for a short interruption is noise. Resumes when MS-0012 closes; if the interruption runs long enough to make the dates wrong, they are cleared then.
metadata.resumeReason: PRJ-0000 completed again at the close of MS-0012. The interruption began and ended on 2026-08-20, so PRJ-0001 resumes with its scope, estimate and already reset target dates unchanged.
